summary: Rust entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Rust

primary.why: Rust is an evolving multiplayer survival game, and the PC version is the original/highest-control route with current Facepunch updates, server selection, graphics settings, and modded/community-server context. Console Edition is a separate branch and should not replace the PC live-service route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC version. Record build/date, server type, wipe state, map seed, mods, account/group state, graphics settings, and whether official or community servers were used.

secondary.exclusive_content: Separate console branch and console-server ecosystem
secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting console-specific progression or controller/performance differences.
secondary.why: Console Edition is not the same live branch as the PC service.

all_releases.platform: Steam Early Access on Windows PC

all_releases.fidelity: Current original live-service branch with best capture/settings route.

all_releases.reason: secondary: compare only for console-specific state.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Completeness is server/date/account dependent, and Console Edition is a separate branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, server, wipe, mods, account state, and branch.
